commands.result: 20,000 deterministic Li bit patterns independently decoded/executed with non-destination register preservation; 26 PC-relative low-12 carry/backward/high-base address checks; six typed-CFG-to-direct-ELF QEMU cases for unsigned div/rem/wrapping arithmetic/shifts

limitations: Independent probe is a temporary local artifact, identified by path and SHA-256; product sources/tests were not modified.
Real .vt source, CLI atomic publication and complete assembled product remain I acceptance scope.
inspection: Ordinary opcode encoding, operand validation and fixed-width layout reviewed directly. Li balanced radix recursion bounded for signed interpretation of arbitrary u64 bits.
All symbolic deltas bounded by 64 MiB text, so theoretical AUIPC signed-high overflow is unreachable for valid internal symbols; high base arithmetic checked separately.
ELF rejects empty text, missing/end labels, writes distinct RX/R/RW PT_LOAD segments with no section headers, and has bounded arithmetic.
Author independent Clang/LLD byte-oracle and QEMU constant/control tests inspected and rerun.
